fields.shapes: the 32 shapes of the finding. text: the whole fake file fragment (apply `assemble` first). secrets: strings that must NOT appear in the redacted text. keep: strings that MUST still appear (key names, directives, structure). v12: what paichart.r10/12 did, measured 2026-11-21. v13Expect: redact, or residual-by-design (SHAPES.md says why).
fields.negatives: text that must come back byte-identical with redactedCount 0.
fields.extraProbes: shapes tried beyond the 32, with the v12 result (mustGo: the string a redaction would remove). No v13 expectation is set here: SHAPES.md section 4 says which families v13 should take.
fields.invariant: for every text in this file: the redacted text has the same number of lines as the input.
